description: A four-channel A/B switcher for audio, CV or gates: each output carries either the A input or the B input of the same number

params.text: Selects the B inputs while it is latched on, and the A inputs while it is off

inputs.text: One of the A inputs, carried to the output of the same number while A is selected, with every polyphonic channel
One of the B inputs, carried to the output of the same number while B is selected, with every polyphonic channel
Selects the B inputs while it is above 1V, whatever the button is set to

outputs.text: Carries the A input of the same number, or the B input while B is selected
0V while A is selected and 10V while B is selected; patch it to another AB4's CV A/B input to switch both together

notes: the two are combined as a logical or, so B is selected when either the button or the CV input calls for it
the change is made at once, in the middle of a gate if one is running, which can produce a click
the module makes no distinction between audio, CV and triggers; the unselected group is dropped rather than faded

inputs.8:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
